areas.name: Mission Gold Ratings
areas.location_cue: Pause menu > Game > Replay Mission, followed by each mission's results checklist.
areas.note: This guide targets every gold rating, not the smaller threshold used by platform reward lists.

levels.1: Try optional timing, accuracy, damage, and route goals during the first attempt.
levels.2: Open the replay entry for Prologue and read every unchecked result condition.
levels.3: Replay the mission and satisfy every displayed condition required by its gold rating. Use Restart Checkpoint only when the results rules retain that condition; otherwise restart the whole mission and verify the gold icon afterward.
